description: Implementation of NetworkQualityStore class managing network quality cache, including adding, retrieving, and observer notification functionalities.

classes.name: NetworkQualityStore
classes.description: Manages a cache of network quality data with observer notification capabilities.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds or updates network quality data in the cache and notifies observers.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves cached network quality data matching a given network ID.

methods.name: AddNetworkQualitiesCacheObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for cache changes and schedules initial notification.

methods.name: NotifyCacheObserverIfPresent
methods.description: Notifies an observer of current cache state if it is registered.
